name: Tandem
hint: Upstairs opens downstairs, downstairs opens upstairs. Keep in step: the rope is short.
why4: Every gate is held open by a 2-plate on the other floor, so each pair needs the other pair standing on a plate.
solution: Leash 6: the floors are 5 apart, so the pairs must stay within ~11 tiles of each other horizontally; every plate is placed so that works.
Downstairs P4 and P3 jump the 2-wide pit at x=5-6 and wait at gate A (x=10).
P1 and P2 stand on U1 (x=6-7): gate A opens. P3 and P4 walk through and stand on L1 (x=13-14): gate E upstairs (x=10) opens.
P1 and P2 walk through E, hop the bump at x=14, stand on U2 (x=17-18): gate F downstairs (x=21) opens.
P3 and P4 step off L1, walk through F and stand on L2 (x=24-25): gate G upstairs (x=21) opens.
P2 and P1 walk through G and hop the 2-high step at x=26-27; P2 touches the key at x=29 and drops through the hole at x=32-34, P1 follows (the rope pulls the others along).
P3 and P4 step off L2; everyone walks to the door at x=42; P2 opens it; all press Down.
